entries.title: The Persona Hierarchy Model: contextual generalization in fine-tuning
entries.summary: The paper proposes that a shared default persona drives behaviour across contexts. Across 120 fine-tuned models, four behaviours and 15 training contexts, narrow generalization correlates with similarity between the training context and the test context.
entries.analysis: Useful mechanism for emergent-misalignment-style generalization; effect sizes unclear from the abstract.

entries.title: How to train your model organism
entries.summary: The authors argue that installing the target behaviour alone is not enough. They add two checks: general-capability preservation and output naturalness. Two public organism suites show problems in chat quality and CoT naturalness.
entries.analysis: Directly affects how much to trust interpretability evals built on model organisms.

entries.title: Are OpenAI's math results "creative" in an important way?
entries.summary: Raemon revisits the disagreement over whether AI gains on verifiable tasks imply concept formation. Skeptics (Tsvi, Byrnes) say models still lack the ability to form new concepts on the fly.
entries.analysis: Live debate tied to this week's OpenAI math release.

entries.title: The Curve Bends You (Zvi)
entries.summary: Zvi argues the de facto plan is to automate alignment research with AI. He says this compounds errors and amounts to going full recursive self-improvement.
entries.analysis: Opinionated but captures post-Curve lab-strategy discussion.

entries.title: AI #189: New Math (Zvi)
entries.summary: OpenAI released solutions to 90 of the top 500 open math problems, at about three hours of Pro-level compute per question. Claude Haiku 5.5 launched at $0.10/$0.50 per million tokens.
entries.analysis: Capability signal; Zvi's math coverage follows.

entries.title: Viral Chinese essay by a DeepSeek kernel engineer
entries.summary: A DeepSeek engineer wrote the main attention kernel of DeepSeek v4.1. His 14 September WeChat essay on AI automating his job argues for open-weight frontier AI. It drew 100k+ reads.
entries.analysis: Window into Chinese lab-insider views on automation and openness.

entries.title: Robust Decentralized Fairness Auditing (Auditopus)
entries.summary: Auditopus lets multiple auditors with partial query sets audit an LLM together. It resists fairwashing by auditors acting for the provider.
entries.analysis: Adversarial-auditor trust model resembles verification problems; check the guarantees.
